text:
Taste grew over 100% in just a couple of days last week. More people joined and started using it than in the previous four months combined.

It sort of feels like I may have accidentally started a company. Which has me wondering if I should do the VC thing again and take a big swing...

But, for now… this week, I’m focused on:

1. Trying to come up with a new product name. "Taste" came from when this project was mostly a joke... poking fun at the X "taste" discourse.
2. A massive redesign. It’s going to start feeling like a workspace. (this will likely ship tomorrow!)
3. Better ways to bring your own judgment into the coding and design process with agents. I want it to go beyond feeling like just a design inspiration repo.
4. If I have time, I will fix/relaunch iOS app (but contemplating depreciating macOS app!)

The ultimate goal of Taste is to make coding agents stop producing slop and make more software that feels like something you’d actually build.
@fawnunwrap Don’t feel bad. It’s part of the fun and I’m here for it.
